title: เร่งตามตัวชายต้องสงสัย คดีฆ่าหั่นศพย่านลาดพร้าว คาดถูกฆ่าที่อื่นนำศพมาโยนทิ้งอำพราง
desc: ผบช.น. เร่งคลี่คลายคดีสะเทือนขวัญ ฆ่าหั่นศพหญิงทิ้งกองขยะท้ายซอยลาดพร้าว 109 แยก 5 คาดถูกฆ่าจากที่อื่นก่อนนำศพมาทิ้งอำพราง อยู่ระหว่างไล่กล้องวงจรปิดล่าตามตัวชายต้องสงสัยแบกกระสอบปุ๋ย
title_cn: 曼谷警方追捕杀人嫌疑人 女性尸体肢解弃于拉差巴先街
summary_cn: 曼谷警方加紧破案，处理一宗涉及肢解尸体的恶性案件。受害者为女性，尸体被弃于拉差巴先街 Ladprao 109 巷五岔口附近的垃圾堆。警方推断受害者在别处被杀害后运来弃尸，目前通过监控录像追捕嫌疑人，嫌疑人曾被摄像头拍到背着编织袋逃离现场。
desc_original: ผบช.น. เร่งคลี่คลายคดีสะเทือนขวัญ ฆ่าหั่นศพหญิงทิ้งกองขยะท้ายซอยลาดพร้าว 109 แยก 5 คาดถูกฆ่าจากที่อื่นก่อนนำศพมาทิ้งอำพราง อยู่ระหว่างไล่กล้องวงจรปิดล่าตามตัวชายต้องสงสัยแบกกระสอบปุ๋ย

summary_cn: 泰国黄金市场价格上调850泰铢。根据泰国黄金交易商协会最新公告，纯金条交易价每克 58000 泰铢，黄金饰品 58800 泰铢/克，1 蚶壳（约3.75克）黄金 14500 泰铢。国际金价上扬带动泰国市场上涨，吸引投资者关注。

title: ผู้กำกับละครดัง จ่อเข้ามอบตัว อ้างเป็น “ตำรวจ ดส.” อุ้มเรียกค่าไถ่ แม่ค้าดอกไม้-ลูกสาว
desc: แม่ค้าขายดอกไม้อาร์ซีเอ ถูกแก๊งอ้างเป็น “ตำรวจ ดส.” อุ้มพร้อมลูกสาว 5 ขวบ รีดเงิน 5 แสน บังคับเซ็นกู้เงิน-คุยโวเคลียร์ยันเบื้องสูง ก่อนจะบุกอุ้มซ้ำขอเพิ่มอีก 3 แสนบาท เกิดเหตุชุลมุน
title_cn: 知名编剧涉嫌冒充警官绑架勒索 花商母女遭敲诈
summary_cn: 警方控告一名知名编剧与犯罪团伙合谋，冒充特警 DS 绑架曼谷 RCA 花商及其5岁女儿。嫌疑人敲诈勒索50万泰铢，强迫受害人签署贷款合同，二次突袭再索30万泰铢。涉及高层人脉，编剧已表示投案自首，案件引发社会关注。

title_cn: 泰国汽油柴油价格日报 11月23日
summary_cn: 11月23日泰国各油品最新零售价。汽油（95型、91型）、高辛烷值油品、柴油等各类燃油来自 PTT、Bangchak、Shell、Caltex、Susco 等供应商。消费者可根据各加油站实时报价进行对比。详见各加油站当日价格公告。

title: IT firms report solid earnings growth
desc: Purchases of new premium smartphones, mainly through instalment plans, business spending on cybersecurity, energy management, high-performance computing and artificial intelligence projects contributed to earnings growth among SET-listed IT companies in the first nine months of 2026.
title_cn: 泰国上市IT企业上半年盈利稳健增长
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易所 SET 上市IT公司2026年前九个月盈利表现良好。消费者通过分期购买高端智能手机、企业对网络安全、能源管理、高性能计算和人工智能项目投资增加，推动了IT行业收益增长。反映泰国数字化转型和消费升级的积极趋势。
desc_original: Purchases of new premium smartphones, mainly through instalment plans, business spending on cybersecurity, energy management, high-performance computing and artificial intelligence projects contributed to earnings growth among SET-listed IT companies in the first nine months of 2026.

title: “ดาต้าเซ็นเตอร์” ไม่ใช่โอสถทิพย์ เตือน! อย่าหวังพึ่งเป็นเครื่องยนต์เศรษฐกิจเพียงด้านเดียว
desc: “เอกนิติ” ดึงยักษ์ใหญ่ญี่ปุ่นขยายลงทุนดาต้าเซ็นเตอร์ หลังดีมานด์โลกโต “โตชิบา” เตือน! อย่าฝากความหวังเศรษฐกิจไว้ที่ดาต้าเซ็นเตอร์อย่างเดียว เหตุจ้างงานน้อย แนะเร่งปั้นเครื่องยนต์อื่นควบคู่
title_cn: 「数据中心」不是经济万能药 专家警告勿单向依赖
summary_cn: 泰国经济学家警告，虽然包括东芝（Toshiba）等日本巨头因全球需求增长而扩大数据中心投资，但不应将所有经济希望寄托于此。数据中心产业创造的就业机会有限，建议泰国并行发展其他经济引擎，实现多元化增长。
desc_original: “เอกนิติ” ดึงยักษ์ใหญ่ญี่ปุ่นขยายลงทุนดาต้าเซ็นเตอร์ หลังดีมานด์โลกโต “โตชิบา” เตือน! อย่าฝากความหวังเศรษฐกิจไว้ที่ดาต้าเซ็นเตอร์อย่างเดียว เหตุจ้างงานน้อย แนะเร่งปั้นเครื่องยนต์อื่นควบคู่

title: Google หนุนไทยฮับดิจิทัลอาเซียน
desc: กฟผ.ผนึก Google พัฒนาโครงสร้างพื้นฐานระบบไฟฟ้า รองรับการขยายตัวของ Data Center ในไทย เดินหน้าพลังงานสะอาดไร้คาร์บอนตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง พร้อมเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการใช้พลังงานในชุมชน
title_cn: Google携手泰国打造亚洲数字枢纽
summary_cn: 泰国电力公司与谷歌（Google）合作开发电力基础设施，支撑数据中心在泰国的扩张。项目将全天候提供清洁无碳电力，同时提升社区能源使用效率。这一举措有助于泰国建立亚洲数字中心的战略地位，促进数字经济发展。
desc_original: กฟผ.ผนึก Google พัฒนาโครงสร้างพื้นฐานระบบไฟฟ้า รองรับการขยายตัวของ Data Center ในไทย เดินหน้าพลังงานสะอาดไร้คาร์บอนตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง พร้อมเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการใช้พลังงานในชุมชน

title: Mobile, fixed broadband value set to reach B452bn
desc: Thailand's mobile and fixed broadband industries are projected to generate a combined economic value of 406 billion baht in 2026, before rising to 452 billion baht by 2030, according to the National Board of Digital Economy and Society Office (BDE).
title_cn: 泰国移动宽带产业规模将达4520亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国国家数字经济与社会办公室（BDE）发布预测数据，全国移动通讯与固定宽带产业2026年经济产值为406亿泰铢，到2030年将增至452亿泰铢。这反映出泰国数字基础设施投资的持续增长趋势。
desc_original: Thailand's mobile and fixed broadband industries are projected to generate a combined economic value of 406 billion baht in 2026, before rising to 452 billion baht by 2030, according to the National Board of Digital Economy and Society Office (BDE).

title: Sea row talks move to KL
desc: Thailand and Cambodia will hold a third round of conciliation talks over their maritime dispute in Kuala Lumpur from Tuesday to Friday under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (Unclos).
title_cn: 泰柬海域争端谈判移至吉隆坡进行
summary_cn: 泰国与柬埔寨就海洋边界纠纷启动第三轮调解谈判，定于本周二至周五在吉隆坡进行。谈判将按照联合国《海洋法公约》（Unclos）框架展开，旨在通过国际法律程序和平解决双方的海域划分争议。
desc_original: Thailand and Cambodia will hold a third round of conciliation talks over their maritime dispute in Kuala Lumpur from Tuesday to Friday under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (Unclos).

title: PCE backs state plan to expand B20 biodiesel use
desc: SET-listed Petchsrivichai Enterprise (PCE) says it is prepared to support the government's plan to expand B20 biodiesel use, citing ample production capacity and a strong supply chain despite concerns over weather-related pressure on palm oil output.
title_cn: PCE公司支持政府扩大B20生物柴油使用
summary_cn: 泰国上市公司佩奇瑞维奇企业（PCE）表示支持政府扩大B20生物柴油应用的计划。该公司拥有充足生产能力和强大供应链网络，尽管天气变化对棕榈油产出造成压力，但PCE对未来供应仍保持乐观，积极推动泰国绿色能源转型。
desc_original: SET-listed Petchsrivichai Enterprise (PCE) says it is prepared to support the government's plan to expand B20 biodiesel use, citing ample production capacity and a strong supply chain despite concerns over weather-related pressure on palm oil output.

title: Ministry downplays fears over arsenic
desc: The Ministry of Public Health has found no cases of acute or chronic arsenic poisoning among residents living and working along the Kok, Sai, Ruak and Mekong rivers, despite concerns over contamination.
title_cn: 公共卫生部否认河水砷污染健康风险
summary_cn: 公共卫生部证实，在克河 Kok、赛河 Sai、瑞河 Ruak 和湄公河沿线居住和工作的居民中，未发现急性或慢性砷中毒病例。这在一定程度上打消了公众对水源砷污染的担忧。公共卫生部的调查结果表明，尽管存在污染顾虑，但目前居民的健康状况良好。
desc_original: The Ministry of Public Health has found no cases of acute or chronic arsenic poisoning among residents living and working along the Kok, Sai, Ruak and Mekong rivers, despite concerns over contamination.

title: Officials step in to ease rice milling fears in Chiang Rai
desc: The government says it is stepping up efforts to support rice farmers in Chiang Rai province, amid concerns over arsenic contamination from polluted border rivers.
title_cn: 政府加大力度支持清莱水稻农民应对砷污染
summary_cn: 清莱省面临边界河流污染导致的砷污染威胁，对当地稻米生产造成冲击。政府宣布加大力度支持受影响的水稻农民，推出措施缓解农民和消费者对食品安全的担忧。该举措旨在稳定当地农业生产，同时重建消费者对清莱米产品的信心，应对跨境河流污染造成的食品安全隐患。
desc_original: The government says it is stepping up efforts to support rice farmers in Chiang Rai province, amid concerns over arsenic contamination from polluted border rivers.

title: Public backs rally, but few  keen to join
desc: Nearly two-thirds of respondents support the protest movement led by Mano Khrueakaew, better known as Kamnan Mano, but most have no intention of joining demonstrations, according to a Nida Poll released on Sunday.
title_cn: 民众支持抗争运动，但参与度不高
summary_cn: 尼达民调（Nida Poll）显示，近三分之二的泰国受访者支持卡南曼诺（Kamnan Mano）领导的抗议运动，支持度相当可观。然而，调查也发现大多数受访者表示无意实际参加示威活动。这反映出泰国民众对抗争运动理念的认可度与实际参与意愿之间存在显著差异，民调于周日发布。
desc_original: Nearly two-thirds of respondents support the protest movement led by Mano Khrueakaew, better known as Kamnan Mano, but most have no intention of joining demonstrations, according to a Nida Poll released on Sunday.

title: Network demands urgent action on river pollution
desc: A civic network has called on the government to step up efforts to tackle heavy-metal contamination in six rivers, including by addressing pollution from mines in Myanmar and speeding up water and soil testing in eight Thai provinces.
title_cn: 民间组织呼吁政府紧急应对河流污染
summary_cn: 一个民间网络组织向政府呼吁加快应对六条河流中的重金属污染问题。该组织要求政府采取措施解决来自缅甸矿山的污染源，并加速在八个泰国省份进行水和土壤检测。这一举动反映出民众对跨境环境污染和食品安全日益关注和担忧。
desc_original: A civic network has called on the government to step up efforts to tackle heavy-metal contamination in six rivers, including by addressing pollution from mines in Myanmar and speeding up water and soil testing in eight Thai provinces.

title: Banks drive growth in second-hand home supply
desc: The growing supply of bank-owned distressed properties is adding to second-hand housing stock while making commercial banks more cautious about extending new home loans, according to the Real Estate Information Center (REIC).
title_cn: 银行不良资产推动二手房供应增长
summary_cn: 房地产信息中心（REIC）指出，银行持有的困难资产正在增加二手房屋供应。这导致商业银行在发放新房贷款时态度变得更为谨慎。这一趋势反映出泰国房地产市场正在调整，可能为首次购房者提供机会，同时也反映出银行对新贷款风险的担忧。
desc_original: The growing supply of bank-owned distressed properties is adding to second-hand housing stock while making commercial banks more cautious about extending new home loans, according to the Real Estate Information Center (REIC).

title: Carmakers face uncertain future
desc: Thailand's automotive industry is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in its history, as carmakers grapple with a challenging mix of economic uncertainty, geopolitical tensions, fierce price competition and the rapid transition towards new-energy vehicles.
title_cn: 汽车制造商面临不确定的未来
summary_cn: 泰国汽车产业正经历历史上最重大的转型期，面临经济不确定、地缘政治紧张、价格竞争激烈、向新能源车转型等多重挑战。业界分析认为，这种由多个因素交织而成的困境，使得泰国汽车制造商必须在短期内应对市场压力，同时为长期的产业转型做好准备。这种不确定性也反映了全球汽车产业正在经历的重大变革。
desc_original: Thailand's automotive industry is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in its history, as carmakers grapple with a challenging mix of economic uncertainty, geopolitical tensions, fierce price competition and the rapid transition towards new-energy vehicles.

title: TikTok Shop identifies key emerging shopping trends
desc: Thai consumers are turning to Thai brands and increasingly buying products discovered through founder-led brand storytelling, livestream demonstrations and short videos, reshaping how local brands compete in the e-commerce market, according to TikTok Shop.
title_cn: TikTok小店发现新兴购物趋势
summary_cn: 泰国消费者的购物习惯正在快速改变，越来越多人倾向选择泰国本土品牌，并通过创始人讲述品牌故事、直播展演、短视频等创新渠道发现和购买产品。这一消费新趋势正在重塑本地品牌在电商市场上的竞争格局，为泰国品牌和中小企业提供了全新的增长机遇，也表明社交电商正逐渐成为泰国零售市场的重要力量。
desc_original: Thai consumers are turning to Thai brands and increasingly buying products discovered through founder-led brand storytelling, livestream demonstrations and short videos, reshaping how local brands compete in the e-commerce market, according to TikTok Shop.

title: Businesses urged to prep for quantum era
desc: Quantum computing could open up new business opportunities for financial services beyond its potential threat to data encryption, with SCBX urging Thai businesses to prepare for both the risks and commercial applications of the emerging technology.
title_cn: 企业需为量子时代做准备
summary_cn: 量子计算技术即将成为现实，既存在风险也蕴含机遇。一方面可能威胁现有数据加密体系；另一方面为金融服务、物流、科研等领域开启新商机。泰国盛盛互联（SCBX）呼吁泰国企业和组织提前认识量子技术的双面性，既要防范潜在风险，更要抓住新兴技术带来的商业机遇，为量子时代的到来做好充分准备。
desc_original: Quantum computing could open up new business opportunities for financial services beyond its potential threat to data encryption, with SCBX urging Thai businesses to prepare for both the risks and commercial applications of the emerging technology.

title: Joint venture pioneers organ transplants
desc: Mahidol University has partnered with SET-listed Betagro Plc and New Zealand-based NZeno Limited to establish a joint venture focused on developing innovations in pig-to-human transplantation, with the ultimate goal of enabling kidney transplants from pigs to humans.
title_cn: 异种器官移植迎来新突破
summary_cn: 玛希隆大学（Mahidol University）与泰国上市企业Betagro Plc及新西兰公司NZeno Limited建立合资企业，共同推进异种器官移植技术研发。该项目聚焦于开发从猪到人的器官移植创新方案，最终目标是实现猪肾脏向人类移植。若成功，这将在医疗领域掀起革命，为数百万需要器官移植的患者提供全新的治疗选择和生存希望。
desc_original: Mahidol University has partnered with SET-listed Betagro Plc and New Zealand-based NZeno Limited to establish a joint venture focused on developing innovations in pig-to-human transplantation, with the ultimate goal of enabling kidney transplants from pigs to humans.

title: Office mulls new option for individual savings scheme
desc: The Fiscal Policy Office (FPO) has proposed adding a new option to the Thailand Individual Savings Account (TISA) scheme, a long-term savings and investment scheme that offers tax deductions, allowing parents to claim tax benefits on investments made for their children's long-term savings.
title_cn: 个人储蓄计划拟增新选项
summary_cn: 泰国财政部建议为「泰国个人储蓄账户」（TISA）这一长期储蓄投资方案增加新选项。新提案的关键亮点是允许父母为子女的长期储蓄和投资申请税收减免优惠。这项措施旨在鼓励家庭进行长期财务规划，特别是针对儿童和青少年的教育储蓄，同时促进国民储蓄率提升，支撑泰国的经济发展。
desc_original: The Fiscal Policy Office (FPO) has proposed adding a new option to the Thailand Individual Savings Account (TISA) scheme, a long-term savings and investment scheme that offers tax deductions, allowing parents to claim tax benefits on investments made for their children's long-term savings.

title: Is all well at the BoT?
desc: An unusual public dispute has recently erupted within the Bank of Thailand, following a sharp public rebuke by its chairman, Somchai Sujjapongse, on Nov 15 over what he described as the central bank's slow progress in reviewing proposed legislative amendments and its failure to reverse the prolonged contraction in SME lending, which has continued for 17 consecutive quarters.
title_cn: 泰国央行前景堪忧
summary_cn: 泰国央行近期出现罕见的内部公开纷争。央行主席索姆柴·素贾蓬（Somchai Sujjapongse）在11月15日对央行工作提出尖锐批评，指责其在审查拟议法律修正案方面进展缓慢，以及未能扭转中小企业（SME）贷款持续萎缩的局面——相关贷款已连续萎缩17个季度。这一罕见的公开内部分歧反映了央行面临的政策执行压力。
desc_original: An unusual public dispute has recently erupted within the Bank of Thailand, following a sharp public rebuke by its chairman, Somchai Sujjapongse, on Nov 15 over what he described as the central bank's slow progress in reviewing proposed legislative amendments and its failure to reverse the prolonged contraction in SME lending, which has continued for 17 consecutive quarters.

title: Small firms urged to seize Chinese growth opportunities
desc: The Office of Small and Medium Enterprise Promotion (Osmep) is urging small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to explore new markets amid growing uncertainty.
title_cn: 泰国中小企业受促开拓中国市场
summary_cn: 在全球经济不确定性加剧的背景下，泰国中小企业委员会（Osmep）主动出击，敦促本国中小企业（SMEs）把握中国市场增长机遇，积极开拓新的商业市场。这一政策导向反映泰国在应对外部经济压力时的战略性调整，鼓励中小企业寻求新的增长点以应对本土市场挑战。
desc_original: The Office of Small and Medium Enterprise Promotion (Osmep) is urging small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to explore new markets amid growing uncertainty.

title: Singer Kong testifies in Gun probe
desc: Popular folk singer Kong Huayrai said that he has provided proof to the authorities that he had donated money to the Gun Jompalang Chuai Su Foundation for families affected by the State Audit Office (SAO) building collapse.
title_cn: 民歌手孔为国家审计局坍塌事件作证
summary_cn: 泰国知名民歌手孔·华叻（Kong Huayrai）就向受国家审计局（SAO）大楼倒塌事件影响的家庭救助基金会Gun Jompalang Chuai Su Foundation捐款一事向当局提供了证明材料。国家审计局大楼坍塌是泰国近年的重大灾难事件，造成大量伤亡，相关部门正在进行深入调查以确认责任。
desc_original: Popular folk singer Kong Huayrai said that he has provided proof to the authorities that he had donated money to the Gun Jompalang Chuai Su Foundation for families affected by the State Audit Office (SAO) building collapse.

title: Four arrested over 'nominee scheme'
desc: Immigration police have arrested a Chinese businessman and three Thai women over a suspected nominee-shareholding scheme aimed at circumventing restrictions on foreign business operations in Chon Buri.
title_cn: 春武里：四人因外资代理股权计划被捕
summary_cn: 春武里府（Chon Buri）移民警察成功破获一起外资规避经营限制的案件，逮捕了1名中国商人和3名泰国女性。他们涉嫌利用代理人持股方案，以泰国公民名义隐性控制企业，从而规避泰国对外资直接经营的法律限制。这类「代理股权计划」是外资非法进入限制性行业的常见手段。
desc_original: Immigration police have arrested a Chinese businessman and three Thai women over a suspected nominee-shareholding scheme aimed at circumventing restrictions on foreign business operations in Chon Buri.

title_cn: 沃拉武德启动「宋素之家奇幻色彩四地区」文化展活动
summary_cn: 泰国官员沃拉武德（Vorawut）启动为期三天的「宋素之家（Sanam Chai）奇幻色彩四地区」大型文化推广活动。活动集中展示宋素地区的传统工艺、特产商品，以及来自泰国北部、中部、东北部、南部四个地区的特色文化，旨在推介地方文化遗产与经济发展。

title_cn: 帕图隆府洪灾 3县被淹已致1人遇难
summary_cn: 泰国南部帕图隆府（Phatthalung）遭遇山洪灾害，3个县区被洪水淹没，水位持续上升。洪水已蔓延至县城主干道，所有车辆需谨慎通行。截至目前已确认1人遇难，灾情仍在发展中。

desc: “ยศชนัน” ลงด่านแม่สายอู้กำเมืองรับฟังผู้ชุมนุม ดึงภาคประชาสังคมร่วมวงเจรจาจีน–เมียนมา ย้ำไม่มีเส้นแบ่งรัฐ–ประชาชน ชวนรวมพลังเป็นเสียงเดียวแก้พิษน้ำกก–สายถึงต้นตอ
title_cn: 副总理赴清莱边镇听民意 动员民间参与中缅对话
summary_cn: 副总理要素嗣（Yodchanan Wongsawat）视察清莱省Mae Sai边镇，听取民众集会意见。他呼吁民间社会与政府合力参与中缅边境对话，统一声音应对跨境河流砷污染问题，强调政府与民众没有分界。

title: People's Party MP Rukchanok's lese majeste appeal decision on Monday
desc: The Court of Appeal will rule on People's Party MP Rukchanok Srinork's lese majeste and computer crime convictions on Monday, a decision that could determine her political future.
title_cn: 人民党女议员拉坤违反君主制案周一宣判
summary_cn: 泰国上诉法院将于周一对人民党议员冰·拉坤（Rukchanok Srinork）的违反君主制及计算机犯罪指控作出裁决。该判决结果将直接影响其政治前程和法律地位，备受国内外关注。
desc_original: The Court of Appeal will rule on People's Party MP Rukchanok Srinork's lese majeste and computer crime convictions on Monday, a decision that could determine her political future.

title: River-arsenic control plan advances, public confidence low
desc: Thailand will block the export to Myanmar of chemicals used ​in rare ‌earth mining, Deputy Prime Minister Yodchanan ‌Wongsawat ​said on Sunday, amid mounting concern over cross-border pollution and specifically arsenic contamination of rivers.
title_cn: 泰国禁出口稀土采矿化学品 河流砷污染防控推进
summary_cn: 泰国副总理周日宣布，泰国将禁止向缅甸出口稀土开采所用的化学品，以防止跨境污染。该举措旨在控制河流砷污染问题，但公众对污染治理效果的信心仍然不足。
desc_original: Thailand will block the export to Myanmar of chemicals used ​in rare ‌earth mining, Deputy Prime Minister Yodchanan ‌Wongsawat ​said on Sunday, amid mounting concern over cross-border pollution and specifically arsenic contamination of rivers.

title: Proxy shares network busted, 7 arrests
desc: Seven suspects have been arrested for alleged involvement in a foreign criminal network using Thai nationals as proxy shareholders to facilitate illegal business activity and property ownership in Chon Buri province.
title_cn: 代理股东网络被破获 7人被逮捕
summary_cn: 泰国警方成功破获一个由外籍犯罪分子主导的跨国非法网络，该网络利用泰国国民作为代理股东掩护，进行违法商业运作和不动产登记，以规避针对外资产权的法律限制。此案发生在春武里府（Chon Buri），7名嫌疑人已被逮捕。案件反映了泰国当局对涉外非法产权活动日益严厉的打击力度，对在泰经营和投资的外资具有警示意义。
desc_original: Seven suspects have been arrested for alleged involvement in a foreign criminal network using Thai nationals as proxy shareholders to facilitate illegal business activity and property ownership in Chon Buri province.

title: Tokenized Deposits จะเปลี่ยนธุรกิจธนาคารยังไง? เมื่อเงินฝากโทเคนใช้ซื้อขายสินทรัพย์ลงทุนบนบล็อกเชน
desc: ทำความรู้จัก Tokenized Deposits แปลงเงินฝากเป็นโทเคน เพื่อใช้ซื้อสินทรัพย์ลงทุนบน Blockchain เทคโนโลยีนี้จะเข้ามาเปลี่ยนบทบาทธุรกิจธนาคารไปอย่างไร ในวันที่โลกกำลังก้าวเข้าสู่ยุค Tokenization
title_cn: 代币化存款如何改变银行业
summary_cn: 文章介绍了代币化存款（Tokenized Deposits）技术，即将传统银行存款转换为可在区块链上交易的数字代币，以便投资者购买数字资产。这项技术代表了金融行业向代币化时代的转变，将改变银行的角色定位——从单纯的资金保管者转变为数字资产生态的参与者。泰国金融体系正面临这一创新浪潮的冲击。
desc_original: ทำความรู้จัก Tokenized Deposits แปลงเงินฝากเป็นโทเคน เพื่อใช้ซื้อสินทรัพย์ลงทุนบน Blockchain เทคโนโลยีนี้จะเข้ามาเปลี่ยนบทบาทธุรกิจธนาคารไปอย่างไร ในวันที่โลกกำลังก้าวเข้าสู่ยุค Tokenization

title_cn: 继承人纳帕特开创「新S曲线」商业帝国
summary_cn: 文章深度剖析泰国商业继承人纳帕特的创新商业战略。这位大家族后代没有简单继承父辈产业，而是另辟蹊径，开创「新S曲线」业务——进军国际五星级酒店和数据中心等战略性高端领域。该案例反映了泰国新一代企业家打破传统、把握全球经济机遇的创新思维，展现了商业继承中的代际更新。

title: Luxury cruise ship brings international tourists to Pattaya
desc: Luxury cruise ship brings international tourists to Pattaya Legacy One of the world’s most luxurious cruise ships , the Seven Seas Explorer, arrived in Chon Buri yesterday, November 21, bringing hundreds of international tourists to explore Pattaya , Sattahip and other destinations in Thailand. Operated by Regent Seven Seas Cruises, the vessel docked at Chuk Samet Port in Sattahip district at around 9am, where tour buses were waiting to take passengers on excursions. Travellers could choose from several destinations, including Nong Nooch Tropical Garden, Pattaya and other attractions in Chon Buri, while some headed to Bangkok. The ship is scheduled to leave the port today, November 22, at approximately 5pm. Its interior features Italian marble, crystal chandeliers and a collection of artworks. The ship measures 224 metres long and 31 metres wide, with a gross tonnage of 55,254 and 13 decks. title_cn: 泰国百年外资企业的成长史
summary_cn: 文章梳理了9家在泰国运营超过100年的外资老字号企业，追溯其从五世皇时代至今的发展历程。这些企业见证了泰国经济从传统贸易向现代商业的转变，反映了外资对泰国经济现代化的重要推动作用。通过这些企业的历史轨迹，可以观察外资与泰国经济增长的相互影响和深度融合。

title: Mongolian woman arrested over theft at Suvarnabhumi Airport
desc: Mongolian woman arrested over theft at Suvarnabhumi Airport Legacy A Mongolian woman was arrested at Suvarnabhumi Airport for allegedly stealing from a Thai passenger . title: Tarutao National Park rangers rescue 22 tourists after boat engine fails
desc: Tarutao National Park rangers rescue 22 tourists after boat engine fails Legacy Park rangers and navy personnel rescued 22 tourists stranded at sea in Satun’s Tarutao National Park after their tour boat’s engine failed on Saturday, November 21, Matichon reported. The group was scuba diving near Koh Phueng when the engine broke down and strong winds pushed the boat away from them. Rescuers took all 22 ashore at Ao Ling on Koh Dong, and the group later returned to Koh Lipe. The head of Tarutao National Park, Surachai Thathet, received the report at about 11.10am. Surachai said the engine failure meant the crew could not reverse the boat to pick up the group, and the rough sea carried it further away. He sent rangers from two park stations to the scene, along with navy personnel based on Koh Lipe. Park officials later found the boat, named Chalam Wan, washed up on the eastern side of Koh Dong. They are inspecting it and will help the operator recover it. Photo courtesy of Matichon Photo courtesy of Matichon In August, rough seas also hit tourist boats on the Andaman coast, when a longtail boat carrying 10 Indian tourists capsized off Krabi after a large wave struck it. title: Proposed AI system claims it can cut river arsenic by 94.6%
desc: Proposed AI system claims it can cut river arsenic by 94.6% Legacy Thailand plans to test an AI-powered water treatment system that simulations suggest could reduce arsenic levels in the Sai River by up to 94.6%, potentially protecting 27,000 rai of farmland in Chiang Rai. The government has approved an 18-month pilot project in Mae Sai, covering the 2027 rainy season , as part of efforts to tackle arsenic contamination in the Kok and Sai rivers. Deputy government spokesperson Patdarasm Thongsaluaykorn said the technology was developed by researchers from Thailand Science Research and Innovation, Naresuan University and the DHI Institute. The system uses AI to monitor water turbidity and divert muddy water into treatment ponds when necessary, where chemicals help separate arsenic-carrying sediment. Treated water is tested before being returned to the river, while contaminated sediment is collected and handled under established safety standards. Photo via Facebook: Suchart Chomklin Researchers tested the design using a digital river model covering 523 days. Simulations showed that three treatment units installed along kilometres 95 to 99 of the Sai River could reduce arsenic levels

title: Anutin orders strict Chiang Mai burning enforcement before smog season
desc: Anutin orders strict Chiang Mai burning enforcement before smog season Legacy Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered northern provinces, above all Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai, to enforce burning laws in full against anyone setting fire to weeds, forests or crop residue before the PM2.5 smog season. Provincial officials must also step up patrols and keep firefighting crews and equipment ready to move in as soon as burning is found. Anutin gave the order at 11am yesterday, November 21, as he chaired a meeting of the National Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Command at Government House in Bangkok, which had been called mainly to deal with contaminated water sources. He also told the provinces to run public awareness campaigns, and he directed the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation to help high-risk areas prepare. At the same meeting, Anutin, who is also interior minister, told the Interior Ministry to prepare for flooding in South Thailand and have relief plans ready in advance. title: Yi Peng festival affects 189 flights in Chiang Mai, Lamphun
desc: Yi Peng festival affects 189 flights in Chiang Mai, Lamphun Legacy Airlines have cancelled 52 flights and rescheduled another 137 ahead of the Loy Krathong and Yi Peng festivals in Chiang Mai and Lamphun, as aviation officials prepare for the release of sky lanterns that could affect aircraft operations. A total of 189 flights will be affected between November 23 and 25, while airlines have scheduled 63 additional flights to accommodate the expected increase in visitors. Deputy Transport Minister Phattharaphong Phattharaprasit announced the preparations on November 20, saying large numbers of Thai and foreign tourists were expected to travel to Chiang Mai and Lamphun for the celebrations on November 24 and 25. He said Aeronautical Radio of Thailand (AEROTHAI) had been instructed to coordinate flight schedules and introduce safety measures to reduce risks from sky lanterns and smoke lanterns. Photo via Ministry of Transport AEROTHAI president Mekin Phetphlai said the agency had worked with airlines to adjust schedules in advance, resulting in 52 cancellations and 137 flight time changes. title: Bangkok’s Prachim Ratthaya Expressway toll rise due December 15, delay studied
desc: Bangkok’s Prachim Ratthaya Expressway toll rise due December 15, delay studied Legacy The car toll on Bangkok’s Prachim Ratthaya Expressway, the Si Rat to Outer Ring Road route, is due to rise from 65 to 80 baht on December 15, but the Expressway Authority of Thailand (EXAT) will meet the operator next week to look at easing the increase or putting it back. Under the new rates, vehicles with more than four and up to 10 wheels will pay 130 baht instead of 105 baht, a rise of 25 baht. Vehicles with more than 10 wheels face the biggest increase, 35 baht, taking their toll from 150 to 185 baht. EXAT said the rise is not a new charge but follows the 30-year concession it signed with Bangkok Expressway and Metro (BEM) on September 14, 2012, which calls for tolls to be reviewed by vehicle type every five years. Tolls last went up in 2021, and the Transport Ministry notice setting the new rates appeared in the Royal Gazette on September 15.
